data_fields.name: reform_threshold
data_fields.donor_constant: reinforcable group under strength when Total <= desired/3

best_idea: A spawn director that adds at most one group per timer pulse, counts live groups per type against a cap, and lets a second, alert-only group type spawn in batches only after the zone is alerted.
decision_why: The one-per-pulse timer, the per-type live cap and the alert gate map onto row 23 zone population, but the donor's unit-mix scoring, its RNG batch and its keep-empty-unstarted-groups rule do not fit our one ledger, so only the shape is taken.
acceptance: Server test: a group def with cap 3 and a 90-tick pulse keeps its live count at or below 3 over 10 simulated minutes, respawns exactly one group per pulse after 3 kills, and an alert-only def spawns only after the zone is alerted.
